description: RISC-V 64 kernel on the QEMU virt board (plan step V1): the loader and the common kernel as one position-independent ELF the tool converts to the PE32+ EDK II loads over OpenSBI; V1.1 boots to the bring-up, V1.2 ports the architecture and the board (Sv48 tables, the trap vector, the time counter, the PLIC), V1.3 brings U-mode components through the common kernel (ecall, frames and contexts, user translation tables, the fixtures and the root task); the other harts are V1.4.
